title: nnU-Net segmentation
description: Generate an immutable segmentation set with an operator-validated nnU-Net model.

gpu_ids.title: GPUs
gpu_ids.x-help: Pick up to 2 GPUs, or leave empty for automatic selection of ready GPUs. Green is ready, yellow is shared with other work, red cannot be used.

compute_profile.title: Compute profile
compute_profile.x-help: The scheduler resources this run asks for. Profiles are made in Settings › Compute and checked against the scheduler; only valid ones are listed.

seg_id.title: Segmentation set name
seg_id.x-help: Optional: lower-case letters, digits, - or _. Empty uses nnunet-<run>.

runtime.env_hint: Activate the torch conda environment and set nnUNet_results to the model results root
